name: The Westin St. Francis
note: Own geometry on the tower grammar (union-square.ts), from Commons photographs: the three sandstone wings and two light courts on Powell, the portico, the copper cornices. The modern tower behind is its own entry (westinTower).

name: Macy's
note: Own geometry on the tower grammar (union-square.ts), from Commons photographs: the one OSM way drawn as its three buildings: the white-marble I. Magnin at Geary and Stockton, the 1980s glass front on Geary with MACY'S and the star, the cream 1928 store with the O'Farrell blade.

name: 450 Sutter
note: Tower grammar on its own rounded footprint (union-square.ts), from Commons photographs: Pflueger's Mayan-deco medical building, buff terracotta ribbed by unbroken piers, two masses, notched parapet.

name: Grand Hyatt San Francisco
note: Tower grammar plus corner piers (union-square.ts), from Commons photographs: SOM's cream slab, blank corner piers running past the roof, window rows between.

name: San Francisco Marriott Union Square
note: Tower grammar (union-square.ts), from Commons photographs: the sawtooth of beige angled bays over a pale grey podium, the red Marriott name.

name: Hotel Nikko San Francisco
note: Tower grammar (union-square.ts), from Commons photographs: grey-beige panels, punched grid, two setbacks, pink granite base.

name: Beacon Grand
note: Tower grammar plus its crown (union-square.ts), from Commons photographs: the Sir Francis Drake's buff brick over cream terracotta, the Starlight Room, the Gothic gables and the gold star.

name: JW Marriott
note: Tower grammar on its rounded footprint (union-square.ts), from Commons photographs: Portman's red-brown brick with cream grid lines and rows of arched window heads, the cream band, the blue canopies.

name: Chancellor Hotel
note: Own geometry on the tower grammar (union-square.ts), from Commons photographs: the buff-brick Powell front with its terracotta top and bracketed cornice, stucco sides, the painted CHANCELLOR HOTEL sign down the south wall.

name: Saks Fifth Avenue
note: Tower grammar (union-square.ts), from Commons photographs: pale buff stone pilaster grid, the rounded Post-Powell corner under the rounded roof band, SAKS FIFTH AVENUE over Post.

name: Tiffany & Company
note: Tower grammar (union-square.ts), from Commons photographs: grey granite grid of dark square windows, the red granite portal, TIFFANY & CO. on the top.

name: Apple Union Square
note: Own geometry (union-square.ts), from Commons photographs: Foster's glass pavilion under its thin overhanging roof slab, the sliding-door glass walls to Post and the plaza, grey metal ends.

name: Neiman Marcus
note: Own geometry on the tower grammar (union-square.ts), from Commons photographs: Johnson and Burgee's harlequin granite block and the glass corner with the City of Paris rotunda behind it.
